identificationModule.briefTitle: Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Pharmacokinetic Characteristics of BAT8008 for Injection
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open Phase I Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerance, Pharmacokinetics and Initial Efficacy of BAT8008 for Injection in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumor

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Objectives:To evaluate the safety and tolerability of BAT8008 for injection in patients with advanced solid tumors, explore the maximum tolerated dose (MTD), and provide the recommended dose for subsequent clinical trials.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this multi-center, open, dose-increasing, dose-expanding Phase I clinical study, rapid titration and a "3+3" dose-increasing design were used to explore the safety, tolerability and PK characteristics of BAT8008 for injection in patients with advanced solid tumors. During the dose-escalation test, appropriate doses were selected for the extended study according to the previous study data.

interventions.name: BAT8008 for Injection
interventions.description: Intravenous infusion, once every 2 weeks (Q2W). It is recommended that the infusion time of the first cycle should be ≥ 3 hours. If no infusion reaction occurs, the subsequent circulation can be completed within 1-2 hours.
otherNames: Recombinant humanized anti Trop2 monoclonal antibody for injection Exetecan conjugate

primaryOutcomes.description: DLT was defined as grade 3 or higher toxicity associated with the investigational product that occurred within 21 days of the subject's initial administration
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 1( first cycle is 21 days, subsequent cycles are 14 days)

primaryOutcomes.description: MTD was defined as exploration in a dose group observed ≤1/6 of subjects during the DLT evaluation period to the highest dose level of DLT.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 1( first cycle is 21 days, subsequent cycles are 14 days)

secondaryOutcomes.description: The area under the concentration-time curve extrapolated from time 0 to infinity
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 91 days after first dose of BAT8008

otherOutcomes.description: presence of anti-drug antibody/ nentralizing antibodies
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: 91 days after first dose of BAT8008
